Theorem
[Ahlfors dichotomy] 1. Theorem 8.4.2\group geometric finitenessSource: thurston:page-0195, thurston:page-0196 For a geometrically finite $\Gamma $, $L_\Gamma $ has spherical measure zero or full measure. In the full-measure case the action on $S^2_\infty $ is ergodic.
Proof

\sketch Extend an invariant bounded boundary function harmonically by visual averaging. The gradient flow preserves volume; outside the convex core the average is strictly below one half, while a finite-volume superlevel set cannot support a complete volume-preserving flow. Density points then force the boundary function to be almost everywhere constant.

□
